translations.web: For this I will lament and wail; I will go stripped and naked; I will howl like the jackals, and moan like the daughters of owls.
translations.bsb: Because of this I will lament and wail; I will walk barefoot and naked. I will howl like a jackal and mourn like an ostrich.
translations.kjv: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.
translations.asv: For this will I lament and wail; I will go stripped and naked; I will make a wailing like the jackals, and a lamentation like the ostriches.
